state.paragraph: On October 3, 2014, the board met, together with members of management and representatives of J.P. Morgan and Wachtell Lipton, to conduct regularly scheduled business and to receive an update on the status of the Profit Improvement Plan, the planning for which had been completed, and on the sale process, including an update on communications with the 27 potentially interested parties as well as Industry Participant that had occurred since the August 13 board meeting. Among other things, the board was informed that approximately 15 parties had expressed interest in participating in the process. In addition, at this meeting, in consultation with its financial and legal advisors, the board reviewed and, for the reasons discussed in August, reaffirmed the determination not to invite Industry Participant to participate in the sale process.

ledger_rows.Note: Privately-held industry competitor; contacted J.P. Morgan after rumours, may revisit spring 2014 talks (PetSmart-initiated merger/acquisition discussions, which IP rebuffed citing antitrust). No price.

Board decided to explore alternatives incl. a sale, with Profit Improvement Plan as standalone fallback; ad hoc committee to oversee; J.P. Morgan outreach deferred to late Sept/early Oct; public announcement planned.

Parties contacted J.P. Morgan (inbound); includes potential lead buyers and large equity suppliers. All 27 reported to board by 10/03. Reasons section: Company “contacted or were contacted by more than 25”.
Inbound contacts to J.P. Morgan, excluding Industry Participant. None signed a confidentiality agreement (all 15 signers were financial).
Press release with Q2 earnings; intended to let parties not contacted approach J.P. Morgan on their own initiative.

Target refused admission: on ad hoc committee direction, J.P. Morgan conveyed concerns (08/22), then said IP not invited (antitrust, information, delay risks); proposals would be considered. Reaffirmed 10/03. No later contact; never entered.
Round 1 opened by the NDA wave (buyers came to target; no outreach wave reported). Board told 10/03 about 15 parties interested.

Confidentiality and standstill agreements. All 15 did diligence in October, had senior-management presentations and detailed business-plan and Profit Improvement Plan information. Includes Buyer Group, Bidder 2 and all IOI submitters.
Non-binding preliminary IOIs due 10/30. Bidders told Longview would roll over up to 7.5 million shares if bidder wished; asked to indicate interest, not a condition.
Preliminary non-binding IOI; range. Consortium led by BC Partners funds (later with CDPQ, GIC, StepStone). Terms beyond price not reported.
Preliminary non-binding IOI; range. Advanced 11/03; on recommended reading, later part of Bidder 3.
Third of three IOIs whose range “reached at least $80.00”; endpoints not disclosed, so price cells blank. Advanced 11/03; on recommended reading, later part of Bidder 3.
Preliminary non-binding IOI at a point price.
Six IOIs in total; the remaining two, prices undisclosed but below the $80.00 cut-off (inferred from the board’s advancement rule). Reasons section says IOIs came from 5 bidder groups.
Due date for non-binding preliminary indications of interest.
15 signers − 6 submitters = 9. J.P. Morgan heard their rationales for not submitting (10/30–11/02); rationales not disclosed. Would be 10 if only 5 IOIs (Q4).
Revises #19 after J.P. Morgan calls on rationales for price levels; raised $78.00 to a range, bringing it above the $80.00 cut-off.

Board advanced four bidders at or above $80.00 (Buyer Group, Bidder 2, Unnamed financial bidders 1 and 2) to the “final round”; November diligence, management presentations, updated FY2014 projections for all.
Below board’s $80.00 cut-off; notified after the meeting. None indicated interest or ability to go above its initial indication.

contact.instructions: `paragraph` reports that the target or its banker contacts potential buyers, or a potential buyer approaches the target, including counts of parties contacted. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.

adviser.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a financial or legal adviser is retained, engaged, terminated or first shown acting for the target, a committee or a bidder. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
